title: Eve HomeKit Accessory Sensor Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eve:accessory value_num=*
| stats sum(value_num) as total_value, avg(value_num) as avg_value by room
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks room values by total and average sensor value across Eve accessory events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `value_num` values for each Eve accessory event and review total and average sensor value by room.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total sensor value.
grandmaExplanation: It steadily which room shows the biggest sensor value numbers in your Eve accessory data.
